sources.title: MEDA bundle readme and release notes
sources.publisher: NASA Planetary Data System, Planetary Atmospheres Node
sources.kind: Document (bundle readme, read with document/meda_release_notes.txt, bundle.xml and the collection labels)
sources.values_read: Readme: the derived level is recommended when it exists; derived products exist only for the Pressure Sensor, Humidity Sensor, certain TIRS channels and the Wind Sensor; derived pressure is based on barocap 3; humidity before sol 63 and wind before sol 36 are not reliable; some uncomputable values are set to an invalid value (9999999999); one CSV per sol; baseline 12 hours per sol at 1 Hz, even hours on even sols and odd hours on odd sols. Release notes: release 16, 2026-08-11, sols 1740-1859; "wind data beyond sol 315 is not provided due to certain damage to some components of the wind sensor, as a result of harsh weather conditions"; on sol 313 a drift-corrected barocap was used from 15:00:05.423 to 18:44:42.043 LMST. bundle.xml: urn:nasa:pds:mars2020_meda version 6.0, DOI 10.17189/1522849. Derived and calibrated collections: version 16.0.
sources.supports: Choice of derived or calibrated products, the quality filters, and the wind data gap after sol 315.
sources.mission_site: Mars 2020 Perseverance rover, MEDA, Jezero crater
sources.observation_dates: Archive from 19 Feb 2021; release 16 reaches sol 1859
sources.note: The RDR SIS (document/meda_env_rdr_sis.pdf) was downloaded but its text could not be extracted with the Python standard library (custom font encoding); column meanings come from the PDS4 labels, the readme and the release notes.

sources.title: Climatologies of the Martian Atmospheric Dust Optical Depth
sources.publisher: Laboratoire de Meteorologie Dynamique (LMD), L. Montabone et al.
sources.kind: Document that links to the data files
sources.values_read: Multiannual climatology from Martian year 24 to 36 from TES, THEMIS and MCS observations, April 1999 to December 2022. Kriged daily maps: 3 deg longitude x 3 deg latitude, one map per sol, NetCDF, 56 MB per year; MY34-36 are version 2.5. Equivalent visible column optical depth = 2.6 x the 9.3 micron absorption column dust optical depth; extinction = 1.3 x absorption. MY35 and MY36 files add earliest, average and latest Modified Julian Dates. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported.
sources.supports: Choice of the dust record, the factor 2.6 to visible optical depth, and the licence.
sources.mission_site: Whole planet (gridded maps); used here at Jezero crater
